column1: # AVO vs the mb/ob path an odd width used to fall back to, and the cost of the
# row-extent clamp + Python argument validation added on 2026-09-18.
# AITER_DISABLE_TOPK_AVO=1 so top_k_per_row_prefill takes mb/ob. Both ops timed in
# one process on one dataset, warmup=20 iters=100, 3 passes per state, GPU idle.
# width = num_prefix + num_rows, so it is also stride0; res1/2/3 are width mod 4.
# States, all with the SAME kernel algorithm -- only the guards differ:
#   pre                 g_25 (5af8af46 at the time): no clamp, no Python validation
#   clamp               RowExtents<true> clamps into [0, pitch]; no Python validation
#   clamp_val_uncached  + validation calling topk_avo_supports() every time (4.86 us/call)
#   shipped             + that call memoised via functools.lru_cache
# Attribution over the 12 shapes: clamp alone +0.06% mean (-0.76% to +1.03%),
# shipped +0.45% mean, so the surviving cost is the Python checks, not the kernel.
